newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish car registrations up 31.9 pct June - SCB.
newsitem.headline: Swedish car registrations up 31.9 pct June - SCB.

text.p: Swedish new car registrations rose 31.9 percent in June to 23,406 vehicles compared to June 1996, Statistics Sweden (SCB) said on Tuesday.
The number of new lorries registered rose 21.4 percent to 2,404 in June compared to June one year earlier.

Industry group AB Bilstatistik, or the Association of Swedish Automobile Manufacturers and Wholesalers, said earlier on Tuesday new car registrations in Sweden rose 25 percent to 20,884 in June compared to a year ago.
